svg.title: 09 Ch4 Where - real map and detail

text.tspan: Chapter 4 "When & where" (b): real map of Australia + linked trend
Real state outlines (ABS 2021, equal-area projection), shaded per 100,000 (5 classes); the ACT is enlarged in a box. Click a state -> ranking (page 09b).
Try this: For pedestrians the Northern Territory is highest. Switch to Cyclists: a different territory leads.
· Australia 10.5 · ACT enlarged in the box
How to use: Click a state (or Tab, arrow keys, Enter) to
compare all states as a ranking.
Highest for pedestrians: Northern Territory (23.5 per 100,000); lowest: ACT (6.3).
Sources: (BITRE, 2023); (ABS, 2026); map boundaries (ABS, 2021) - ASGS Edition 3, CC BY 4.0, generalised to 66 KB.
▸ Show the data as a table

ACT is ~0.03% of the area (4x7 px):
enlarged in a box + dashed leader;
the box is the ACT's button
